findings.claim: The plan missed .okf/decisions/index.md's note on ADR 0012 and left the test file out of touches.

ADR 0020's Decision and ADR 0011's last rule-path correction gave apm/ (with apm/claude/ and apm/antigravity/) as kmctl's package home with no ADR 0045 correction. The plan now adds dated corrections to both, lists both files in touches, and row r1 checks all five ADRs.
